name: Seika Racing
tagline: An amateur sailing team racing the Rías of Galicia.
description: Seika Racing is an amateur sailing team racing an IMX 40 out of the Rías Baixas, Galicia. We're open to new crew, we film what we do, and we're building a race analytics app.
